To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the capture efficiency of particles is strongly influenced by the packing structures and the particle size.

the force analysis depicts that among the chosen granular bed packing structures, the body-centered packing structure gives the highest capture efficiency due to the highest packing porosity and the lowest pressure drop due to the highest porosity.

the face-centered packing structure gives the highest capture probability of particles and the lowest packing porosity, and the body-centered packing structure gives a better capture efficiency of particles than those of the simple cubic and face-centered packing structure.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the capture efficiency of submicron/nanoparticles in the granular filter beds is a function of the packing structure of the granular filter, the porosity and the particle diameter.
the capture efficiency and pressure drop of a granular bed filter are strongly dependent on the granular bed structures, the porosity and the diameter of the suspended particles.
the face-centred packed granular bed is the most suitable packing structure for the deep bed filtration of submicron/nanoparticles suspension due to the lowest porosity and the highest pressure drop.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the face-centered packed granular bed has the greatest capture efficiency and pressure drop among the chosen granular packing structures while the simple cubic packed filter has the lowest pressure drop.
the force analysis on the particle motion path in granular packed filter bed could be used to understand the mechanism of the deep-bed filtration.

the force analysis of the deep bed granular filter mechanism is a powerful tool in understanding the capture efficiency of submicron and nanometer particles in granular filter beds and the results obtained from this work could be useful for the design of the granular filter beds in the water and wastewater industries.

the packing porosity of the granular filter beds is an important factor that influences the capture probability of submicron/nanoparticles on a granular filter beds.
